source_document: CUT programme web pages (www.cut.ac.za/programmes), fetched 13 Nov 2026

university.name: Central University of Technology, Free State

application_periods.label: General
application_periods.notes: Applications are free. No late or walk-in applications.

aps_rule.notes: Six subjects on the 8-point scale plus Life Orientation, which counts a maximum of 1 point. General minimum 27; 22-26 may be asked to write a selection test; 21 or below not admitted.

faculties: Faculty of Engineering, Built Environment and Information Technology
Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences

courses.faculty: Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. Code HLHCDL. 1 year full-time or 2 years part-time. Physical Sciences must be taken in Grade 12 (no minimum printed; 30% used). No programme APS is published; CUT's general minimum of 27 is used. Merit selection; aptitude test may be required.

courses.name: Diploma in Agricultural Management
courses.faculty: Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. Code D_AGM. Below APS 23 not considered. Page lists one of these subjects at 50% as 'recommended'. Page prints duration as 1 year; 360 credits is a 3-year diploma. Formal selection.

requirements.description: Accounting, Mathematics, Business Studies, Economics, Hospitality Studies or Consumer Studies

courses.name: Diploma in Somatology
courses.faculty: Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. Code DP_SOM. No programme APS is published; CUT's general minimum of 27 is used. Selection may include aptitude test and/or interview. Extended programme for applicants one level short in one subject or APS.

courses.name: Bachelor of Health Sciences in Clinical Technology
courses.faculty: Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. Code B_CLINT. Selection programme.

courses.faculty: Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. Code B_MLS. APS 35+ may get direct admission; 30-34 may be referred for psychometric evaluation. Maths Lit not accepted. Formal selection. Extended programme for applicants one level short in one subject or APS.

courses.name: Bachelor of Radiography in Diagnostics
courses.faculty: Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. Code HCBCRD. Formal selection, second round after final NSC results (test or interview). Extended programme for applicants one level short in one subject or APS.

courses.name: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Health
courses.faculty: Faculty of Health and Environmental Sciences
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. Code B_ENVH. No programme APS is published; CUT's general minimum of 27 is used. Selection may apply. Extended programme for applicants one level short in one subject or APS.

courses.name: Diploma in Design and Studio Art
courses.faculty: Faculty of Humanities
courses.notes: Campus: Bloemfontein. No programme APS is published; CUT's general minimum of 27 is used. Portfolio and interview required; Visual Arts highly recommended. An extended (ECP) version also exists.
